bug: Injected client calling embeddings.create(**args) was not recognised
fix: OpenAI-shaped embeddings calls with a payload splat count, like chat and responses

bug: Mistral SDK calls through a getter or attribute (self.get_client().chat.complete) were missed
fix: Vendor-specific method paths count when that vendor's SDK is imported in the file

bug: Anthropic calls were dropped when anthropic was imported dynamically
fix: messages.create with Anthropic's own signature (model + max_tokens/messages/system) counts; Twilio/Slack/Plivo signatures don't

bug: messages.create(**payload) in a file that uses Claude was dropped
fix: A payload splat counts when the file mentions Anthropic or Claude

bug: DashScope Generation.call reached through a class attribute was missed
fix: Module functions match as a suffix of the call chain

bug: Assistants API: threads.messages.create counted as a model call; threads.runs.create (the billed call) was missed
fix: Runs count, thread messages don't

bug: Bedrock converse() in a file without a boto import was dropped
fix: converse with modelId/inferenceConfig counts

bug: Bedrock converse/invokeModel in Java and Kotlin was not covered
fix: AWS SDK for Java/Kotlin Bedrock Runtime patterns added

bug: messages().createStreaming(...) was missed
fix: Streaming variants of the official Java SDK calls added

bug: Spring AI model builders (OpenAiChatModel.builder()) were missed
fix: Spring AI builders recognised, provider read from the class name

bug: Kotlin multiplatform test folders (src/jvmTest) were scanned as app code
fix: src/*Test/ folders and *Test/TestBase/TestUtils files treated as tests

bug: .post("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages") was dropped as a server route
fix: A route never includes a full https host: such lines are client calls

bug: Billing names like qwen/qwen-plus or meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b didn't match qwen-plus in code
fix: Router vendor namespaces and :free/:nitro suffixes are stripped when matching

bug: A name assigned hundreds of times made model resolution exponential (scan ran over 11 minutes)
fix: Per-file memo with a cycle guard; the worst case now takes 0.02 s

bug: Absolute URLs containing /api/ were treated as the app's own route
fix: Only relative /api/ paths count as own routes

bug: C# (.NET Interactive) notebooks were skipped
fix: Non-Python notebooks run through the matching language scanner, reported by cell

bug: C# cells inside a notebook whose kernel says Python were dropped
fix: Cells are routed by their own language metadata

bug: client.responses.create (official openai-ruby) was missed
fix: Pattern added

bug: The string tokenizer skipped "/chat/completions" after a short string like "/"
fix: Literals of any length, including escaped quotes, are read whole

bug: OpenAI-shaped clients called positionally or without a model argument were missed
fix: chat.completions.create with positional args or messages= counts

bug: unittest/ folders were scanned as app code
fix: unittest(s)/ treated as tests

bug: Twilio's messages.create was reported as an LLM call
fix: Anthropic-shaped JS calls need Anthropic or Claude in the file

bug: Bedrock converse(model_id: ...) without the AWS constant in the file was missed
fix: converse with model_id: counts
